title: users
description: Per-user state across the whole bot: aliases, lastseen, optouts, blocks, supporter status. Created on first sighting in src/handlers/listener/update-user.js.

userid.description: Twitch user id (immutable; primary lookup key)

aliases.description: Every login this user has ever had (appended on rename)

currAlias.description: Current Twitch login (kept in sync via user-update event)

lsChannel.description: Channel where the user was last seen

firstSeen.description: Unix seconds of first message (added on newer docs)

optoutLs.description: When true, !lastseen <user> refuses to reveal this user

optoutStalk.description: When true, !stalk refuses to reveal this user

optoutRemind.description: When true, this user cannot be a reminder recipient

optoutOwnChannel.description: When true, !lastseen/!stalk hide that this user is the broadcaster

blocks.description: Per-feature block lists controlled by the user

remind.description: Twitch user ids the user has blocked from sending them reminders

isPlus.description: Set by !setplus on supporters of R$10+

lastSupportDate.description: Unix seconds of most recent supporter status assignment

totalDonated.description: Cumulative donated amount as recorded by !setplus

msgCount.description: Legacy per-channel message counters carried over from the Python bot. Not written by this repo.
